source: Microsoft Word Agent Skill Catalog (636 candidate skills / 53 categories)
notes: Each skill maps to exactly one operation implemented by tools-word-doc-agent.py.
engine=native: the operation reads or writes OOXML for that capability.
engine=advisory: the tool produces a validated procedure/checklist instead of a UI action.
Descriptions in the source catalog are boilerplate; routing uses the skill name, category purpose and surface list.
